description: This file contains functions for normalizing the order of graphical elements, including grouping, sorting bound elements, and maintaining z-index order in an Excalidraw-like application.

methods.name: normalizeGroupElementOrder
methods.description: Sorts elements based on group hierarchy, ensuring grouped elements are ordered correctly.

methods.name: normalizeBoundElementsOrder
methods.description: Sorts container elements and their bound text elements together, maintaining relative order.

methods.name: normalizeElementOrder
methods.description: Main exported function that normalizes element order by combining group and bound element sorting.
